content.content:
APP := FrameJob
BUILD_DIR := build
APP_PATH := $(BUILD_DIR)/Build/Products/Release/Frame Job.app
# The Distribution configuration's product (`make dist`): Release without
# FRAMEJOB_DEV_TOOLS, in its own products folder beside Release's.
DIST_PATH := $(BUILD_DIR)/Build/Products/Distribution/Frame Job.app
# The Debug configuration's product (`make app-debug`): "Frame Job Debug",
# com.kgalligan.FrameJob.debug (spec §11 V-5), in its own products folder.
DEBUG_APP_PATH := $(BUILD_DIR)/Build/Products/Debug/Frame Job Debug.app

# `xcodebuild` records every task's ENVIRONMENT in its build database under
# build/Build/Intermediates.noindex/XCBuildData/, so a `make app` from a shell
# that exports the AssemblyAI key or the Anthropic key writes that key to disk
# (road map 6 §10.12, measured). `unexport` covers every
# recipe in this file, which is what the proofs' own `child_env()` already
# does for themselves; `tools/proof/makefile_env_proof.py` measures `app`,
# one "holds the dummy" row per key.
unexport RC_ASSEMBLYAI_KEY
unexport ANTHROPIC_API_KEY

.PHONY: all app app-debug dist rust codecs test lint fmt typecheck project run clean prices gate

all: app

rust:
	cd core && cargo build --release

# The bundled encoders (road map "codec-export" C0, spec §11 CX-4, CX-5): SVT-AV1
# and libvpx from pinned, SHA-256-checked tarballs, built arm64, static and
# encoder-only into build/codecs/ (headers, archives, licence texts), reused
# by its stamp — like cargo, a no-op when nothing changed. Needs cmake
# (`brew install cmake`), the system perl, and the network for the first
# fetch. project.yml's "Build Codecs" step runs the same script.
codecs:
	python3 tools/codecs/build_codecs.py

# `assistant_lane_proof.py` is spec §11 AI-3's `make test`-reachable probe
# (the agent lane); `rust` first, because it links the staticlib.
# `prices_proof.py` is road map 13 P1's price function: the Python reader and
# the helper's `bun test` (agent/build.sh test) against one fixture file, no
# network. `budget_proof.py` is P3's proofs' ledger and monthly budgets (spec
# §11 P-6), over scratch ledgers only, no network. `inventory.py --check` checks the
# menu inventory's sites against app/Sources, each found by its token and
# enclosing function rather than its line, and its other citations by
# anchor; no app, no build. `spec_index_proof.py` (issue batch B70) checks the
# spec indexes' Lines cells against `wc -l` and a row for every spec file.
# `proof_defaults.py` (issue batch B83, #238) is the defaults removal recipe
# on a throwaway domain, its refusals over scratch folders, then the sweep of
# the proofs' own idle domains, and of the two probes this target ran, out of
# `~/Library/Preferences`; no app.
# `mcp-proxy` is road map 14's `framejob-mcp`, its tests black-box over the
# built binary's stdin and stdout. `name_residue.py` (spec §11 NM-8) fails
# on any line or path spelling the old name that its allow-list does not
# hold; its selftest runs first. `appcast.py --selftest` (spec §11 PUB-6, PUB-8)
# is the publish workflow's appcast writer over a stand-in `sign_update`: no
# network, no key. `build_codecs.py --selftest` (codec-export C0) is the
# encoder build's key, reuse and digest rules, no network and no cmake; `codecs`
# first, because swift_build.py's selftest links the archives.
test: rust codecs
	cd core && cargo test --release
	cd graphic && cargo test --release
	cd mcp-proxy && cargo test --release
	python3 tools/proof/assistant_lane_proof.py
	python3 tools/proof/assistant_prompt_proof.py --probe
	python3 tools/proof/prices_proof.py
	python3 tools/proof/budget_proof.py
	python3 tools/proof/capture_spike/inventory.py --check
	python3 tools/proof/spec_index_proof.py
	python3 tools/codecs/build_codecs.py --selftest
	python3 tools/proof/swift_build.py --selftest
	python3 tools/proof/proof_app.py --selftest
	python3 tools/proof/gate.py --selftest
	python3 tools/proof/appcast.py --selftest
	python3 tools/proof/proof_defaults.py --ran assistant_lane_probe --ran assistant_prompt_probe
	python3 tools/proof/name_residue.py --selftest
	python3 tools/proof/name_residue.py

lint:
	cd core && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
	cd graphic && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
	cd mcp-proxy && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings

fmt:
	cd core && cargo fmt
	cd graphic && cargo fmt
	cd mcp-proxy && cargo fmt

# The base version is the VERSION file (spec §11 PUB-2, Rasterize's scheme),
# passed to xcodegen as RC_BASE_VERSION for project.yml's MARKETING_VERSION. A
# missing VERSION stops here rather than generating a project with a blank
# version; a bare `xcodegen generate` has no such guard, so never run it.
project:
	base="$$(cat VERSION)" && RC_BASE_VERSION="$$base" xcodegen generate

app: rust codecs project
	xcodebuild -project $(APP).xcodeproj -scheme $(APP) -configuration Release \
		-derivedDataPath $(BUILD_DIR) build

# The Debug app the proofs can drive (tools/proof/proof_app.py): unoptimised,
# so it rebuilds in seconds after a one-file edit; never the index store.
app-debug: rust codecs project
	xcodebuild -project $(APP).xcodeproj -scheme $(APP) -configuration Debug \
		-derivedDataPath $(BUILD_DIR) COMPILER_INDEX_STORE_ENABLE=NO build

# Builds the Distribution configuration (Release without FRAMEJOB_DEV_TOOLS,
# spec §11 V-1) beside Release's product, then runs the binary check: the
# dev-tools marker must be absent from Distribution's binary and present in
# Release's, which is its positive control; and each bundle's assistant helper
# (Contents/Helpers/framejob-agent) must be present, signed with the hardened
# runtime, hold exactly the allow-jit entitlement and not hold the marker
# (road map 12 A4, D6–D13); and the Distribution app must be signed with
# exactly the audio-input and camera entitlements, never get-task-allow
# (#145, spec §11 CAM-3, D14); and

content.content:
name: FrameJob
options:
  bundleIdPrefix: com.kgalligan
  deploymentTarget:
    macOS: "26.0"
  createIntermediateGroups: true

# Distribution is Release without FRAMEJOB_DEV_TOOLS (spec §11 V-1): `make dist`
# builds it and checks the binary; Debug and Release carry the dev tools.
configs:
  Debug: debug
  Release: release
  Distribution: release

# Sparkle 2, the published build's updater (spec §11 PUB-6..PUB-9). xcodegen
# links a package per target, not per configuration, so Sparkle.framework is
# embedded in every configuration but loaded only in Distribution (PUB-7):
# Debug and Release drop its load command (`-dead_strip_dylibs` below); only
# Distribution compiles code that uses it (FRAMEJOB_UPDATER below) and holds a
# feed and a key. The first build fetches the package over the network.
packages:
  Sparkle:
    url: https://github.com/sparkle-project/Sparkle
    exactVersion: "2.10.1"

targets:
  FrameJob:
    type: application
    platform: macOS
    sources:
      - path: app/Sources
      - path: app/Assets.xcassets
      - path: app/Resources/Fonts
        type: folder
        buildPhase: resources
      - path: app/Resources/Models
        type: folder
        buildPhase: resources
      # A one-frame 16x16 black movie. A timeline of nothing but text, shapes
      # and images owns no composition track, and AVFoundation gives a
      # composition of empty edits a duration of ZERO — so nothing renders
      # offline. This is the minimum real content that gives such a project a
      # track to tick against; the compositor never samples it.
      - path: app/Resources/Blank.mp4
        buildPhase: resources
      # 10 s of ALAC digital silence, 48 kHz stereo (spec §11 #336). An audio
      # track whose every clip has no source is nothing but empty edits, which
      # an export cannot read; this fills it back to back with real silence.
      - path: app/Resources/Silence.caf
        buildPhase: resources
      - path: app/Resources/Shaders
        buildPhase: sources
    # Sparkle (spec §11 PUB-7): embedded in every configuration, loaded only
    # in Distribution.
    dependencies:
      - package: Sparkle
    settings:
      base:
        PRODUCT_NAME: "Frame Job"
        # The module NSDocumentClass names, the same in every configuration: a
        # PRODUCT_NAME with a space would derive Frame_Job (spec §11 NM-3).
        PRODUCT_MODULE_NAME: FrameJob
        # The Rust core is built for the host arch only; for a universal app,
        # cargo-build both targets and lipo them, then widen this.
        ARCHS: arm64
        SWIFT_VERSION: "5.0"
        ASSETCATALOG_COMPILER_APPICON_NAME: AppIcon
        SWIFT_OBJC_BRIDGING_HEADER: app/Bridging/FrameJob-Bridging-Header.h
        LIBRARY_SEARCH_PATHS:
          - $(PROJECT_DIR)/core/target/release
        # The bundled encoders (spec §11 CX-4, CX-5): their headers for the
        # bridging header, and their two static archives linked by full path
        # (never -l, so no codec dylib can ever be picked instead) in this list
        # and in Debug's and Release's, which replace it; Distribution inherits it.
        HEADER_SEARCH_PATHS:
          - $(PROJECT_DIR)/build/codecs/include
        OTHER_LDFLAGS:
          - -lframejob_core
          - $(PROJECT_DIR)/build/codecs/lib/libSvtAv1Enc.a
          - $(PROJECT_DIR)/build/codecs/lib/libvpx.a
        MTL_LANGUAGE_REVISION: UseDeploymentTarget
        ENABLE_USER_SCRIPT_SANDBOXING: "NO"
        ENABLE_HARDENED_RUNTIME: "YES"
        CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY: "-"
        CODE_SIGN_STYLE: Manual
        DEVELOPMENT_TEAM: ""
        MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: "26.0"
        # The base version lives in VERSION (spec §11 PUB-2), as Rasterize's
        # does; `make project` exports it as RC_BASE_VERSION (a bare `xcodegen
        # generate` leaves it blank). Local builds read "0.2 (0)"; the publish
        # workflow overrides both settings with "<base>.<run number>" and the
        # run number.
        MARKETING_VERSION: ${RC_BASE_VERSION}
        CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION: "0"
      # The dev-tools seam (AgentServer+DevTools.swift) compiles only under this
      # condition; `$(inherited)` keeps the project-level DEBUG in Debug.
      configs:
        Debug:
          SWIFT_ACTIVE_COMPILATION_CONDITIONS: "$(inherited) FRAMEJOB_DEV_TOOLS"
          # Sparkle is never loaded here (spec §11 PUB-7): no Debug code
          # references it, so the linker drops its load command. Loaded, dyld
          # refuses an ad-hoc framework under the hardened runtime's library
          # validation ("different Team IDs") and the app cannot launch. A
          # per-config OTHER_LDFLAGS replaces the base one, so the core is
          # restated, and so are the encoders' archives (CX-4).
          OTHER_LDFLAGS:
            - -lframejob_core
            - $(PROJECT_DIR)/build/codecs/lib/libSvtAv1Enc.a
            - $(PROJECT_DIR)/build/codecs/lib/libvpx.a
            - -Xlinker
            - -dead_strip_dylibs
          # Xcode 26 splits a Debug executable into a stub and __preview.dylib,
          # and Write Agent Catalog's `codesign -s - -f "$exe"` fails on the split.
          ENABLE_DEBUG_DYLIB: "NO"
          # The Debug build is its own app (spec §11 V-5, NM-3): "Frame Job
          # Debug", its own bundle id and defaults domain, and an Alternate
          # `.framejob` handler, so a double-click opens the real Frame Job.
          # Info.plist reads PRODUCT_NAME for both names and the RC_ setting
          # through `:default=`, so Release and Distribution, which take the
          # base PRODUCT_NAME and leave the handler rank unset, keep theirs.
          PRODUCT_NAME: "Frame Job Debug"
          PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER: com.kgalligan.FrameJob.debug
          RC_PROJECT_HANDLER_RANK: Alternate
        Release:
          SWIFT_ACTIVE_COMPILATION_CONDITIONS: "$(inherited) FRAMEJOB_DEV_TOOLS"
          # As Debug's: Sparkle embedded, never loaded (spec §11 PUB-7;
          # tools/proof/dist_check.py D35 holds it). The encoders' archives
          # restated as Debug's are (CX-4).
          OTHER_LDFLAGS:
            - -lframejob_core
            - $(PROJECT_DIR)/build/codecs/lib/libSvtAv1Enc.a
            - $(PROJECT_DIR)/build/codecs/lib/libvpx.a
            - -Xlinker
            - -dead_strip_dylibs
        # Distribution is the build that ships (spec §11 V-1), and notarization
        # refuses the get-task-allow Xcode injects by default, so it is signed
        # with `entitlements` alone (#145, tools/proof/dist_check.py D14).
        Distribution:
          CODE_SIGN_INJECT_BASE_ENTITLEMENTS: "NO"
          # The updater (spec §11 PUB-6..PUB-9) is Distribution's alone:
          # AppDelegate+Updates.swift compiles only under FRAMEJOB_UPDATER, and
          # Info.plist reads the feed and the EdDSA public key through
          # `:default=` (V-5's pattern), so Debug and Release hold neither.
          # The public key is the owner's (PUB-8); until it lands it is empty
          # and dist_check.py's D31 and published_check.py's P20 refuse it.
          SWIFT_ACTIVE_COMPILATION_CONDITIONS: "$(inherited) FRAMEJOB_UPDATER"
          RC_SPARKLE_FEED_URL: https://github.com/kpgalligan/framejob/releases/latest/download/appcast.xml
          RC_SPARKLE_PUBLIC_KEY: ""
    info:
      path: app/Info.plist
      properties:
        CFBundleName: "$(PRODUCT_NAME)"
        CFBundleDisplayName: "$(PRODUCT_NAME)"
        CFBundleShortVersionString: $(MARKETING_VERSION)
        CFBundleVersion: $(CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION)
        LSMinimumSystemVersion: "26.0"
        LSApplicationCategoryType: public.app-category.video
        NSPrincipalClass: NSApplication
        NSHighResolutionCapable: true
        ATSApplicationFontsPath: Fonts
        NSHumanReadableCopyright: ""
        # Sparkle's feed and EdDSA public key (spec §11 PUB-6, PUB-8): set in
        # Distribution alone, empty in Debug and Release (PUB-7). No
        # SUEnableAutomaticChecks and no SUAutomaticallyUpdate: Sparkle's own
        # defaults apply (PUB-9).
        SUFeedURL: "$(RC_SPARKLE_FEED_URL:default=)"
        SUPublicEDKey: "$(RC_SPARKLE_PUBLIC_KEY:default=)"
        # File ▸ New Recording… (road map 3, R1c) — the microphone half of a
        # recording, which speech never needed (the speech engine reads an
        # extracted file). The microphone takes TWO things, and this key is one:
        # NSMicrophoneUsageDescription, or AVCaptureDevice.requestAccess and
        # the first AVCaptureDeviceInput CRASH the app; and under the hardened
        # runtime the entitlement com.apple.security.device.audio-input
        # (`entitlements` below), without which the grant is refused however
        # the person answers the prompt. Screen Recording has neither key nor
        # entitlement: its prompt is triggered by the first capture or by
        # CGRequestScreenCaptureAccess().
        NSMicrophoneUsageDescription:
          Frame Job records the microphone you choose alongside a screen recording, into
          a file of its own beside the movie. Nothing is sent anywhere.
        # The camera half of a recording (camera-recording CR1a, spec §11 CAM-3)
        # takes the same two things as the microphone: this key, without which
        # AVCaptureDevice.requestAccess(for: .video) and the first camera
        # AVCaptureDeviceInput CRASH the app, and the entitlement
        # com.apple.security.device.camera (`entitlements` below). No
        # NSCameraUseContinuityCameraDeviceType: CR0's D2 listed the iPhone's
        # Continuity Camera without it.
        NSCameraUsageDescription:
          Frame Job records the camera you choose, into a file of its own. Nothing is
          sent anywhere.
        UTExportedTypeDeclarations:
          - UTTypeIdentifier: com.kgalligan.framejob-project
            UTTypeDescription: Frame Job Project
            UTTypeConformsTo: [com.apple.package]
            UTTypeTagSpecification:
              public.filename-extension: [framejob]
        CFBundleDocumentTypes:
          - CFBundleTypeName: Frame Job Project
            LSItemContentTypes: [com.kgalligan.framejob-project]
            CFBundleTypeRole: Editor
            NSDocumentClass: FrameJob.ProjectDocument
            LSTypeIsPackage: true
            LSHandlerRank: "$(RC_PROJECT_HANDLER_RANK:default=Owner)"
          # Opening a media file makes an UNTITLED project sized to it with
          # the file as the first clip (spec 1) — the app is an Alternate
          # handler for each so Open With… works from the Finder.
          - CFBundleTypeName: QuickTime Movie
            LSItemContentTypes: [com.apple.quicktime-movie]
            CFBundleTypeRole: Editor
            NSDocumentClass: FrameJob.ProjectDocument
            LSHandlerRank: Alternate
          - CFBundleTypeName: MPEG-4 Movie
            LSItemContentTypes: [public.mpeg-4, com.apple.m4v-video]
            CFBundleTypeRole: Editor
            NSDocumentClass: FrameJob.ProjectDocument
            LSHandlerRank: Alternate
          - CFBundleTypeName: Movie
            LSItemContentTypes: [public.movie]
            CFBundleTypeRole: Editor
            NSDocumentClass: FrameJob.ProjectDocument
            LSHandlerRank: Alternate
          - CFBundleTypeName: Audio
            LSItemContentTypes:
              [com.apple.m4a-audio, public.mp3, com.microsoft.waveform-audio, public.aiff-audio]
            CFBundleTypeRole: Editor
            NSDocumentClass: FrameJob.ProjectDocument
            LSHandlerRank: Alternate
          - CFBundleTypeName: Image
            LSItemContentTypes: [public.png, public.jpeg, public.heic]
            CFBundleTypeRole: Editor
            NSDocumentClass: FrameJob.ProjectDocument
            LSHandlerRank: Alternate
    # The hardened-runtime entitlement the microphone needs (road map 3, R0's
    # second surprise: a bare swiftc probe never needs it, the signed app
    # does), and the camera's, added on that finding (spec §11 CAM-3: CR0
    # measured only a bare binary under the terminal's grant). The file is
    # GENERATED by xcodegen from these properties, like app/Info.plist, and
    # git-ignored beside it.
    entitlements:
      path: app/FrameJob.entitlements
      properties:
        com.apple.security.device.audio-input: true
        com.apple.security.device.camera: true
    preBuildScripts:
      # The bundled encoders (road map "codec-export" C0, spec §11 CX-5):
      # tools/codecs/build_codecs.py fetches, checks and builds SVT-AV1 and
      # libvpx into build/codecs/, or reuses them by its stamp (a no-op costs
      # well under a second), so the step runs every build. The PATH is Build
      # Rust Core's without cargo; the script also finds cmake in
      # /opt/homebrew/bin or /usr/local/bin when Xcode's PATH lacks Homebrew,
      # and builds under its own scrubbed environment, so this step and a
      # shell's `make codecs` compute one key.
      - name: Build Codecs
        basedOnDependencyAnalysis: false
        script: |
          set -e
          export PATH="/usr/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"
          python3 "$PROJECT_DIR/tools/codecs/build_codecs.py"
        outputFiles:
          - $(PROJECT_DIR)/build/codecs/lib/libSvtAv1Enc.a
          - $(PROJECT_DIR)/build/codecs/lib/libvpx.a
      - name: Build Rust Core
        # cargo decides staleness, so the step runs every build (a no-op
        # costs 0.1 s).
        basedOnDependencyAnalysis: false
        script: |
          set -e
          # /usr/bin is ahead of Xcode's own PATH, so `cc` is the xcrun shim a
          # shell finds and not the toolchain's clang: with SDKROOT unset (below) that
          # clang has no SDK, and a COLD build of rquickjs-sys's C stops at
          # "'stdlib.h' file not found". `make app` never met it, because
          # `make rust` builds first; an archive on a fresh checkout does.
          export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:/usr/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"
          cd "$PROJECT_DIR/core"
          # Xcode exports MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET and SDKROOT, a shell's
          # `make rust` neither, and rquickjs-sys's build script reruns when
          # MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET changes: with them set, the shell build
          # and this step rebuilt rquickjs-sys, graphic and core in turn, and
          # a tree copy's step (its `core` is a symlink) rewrote the tree's
          # core/target (#225). Unset, both builds are the same build.
          env -u MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET -u SDKROOT cargo build --release
        outputFiles:
          - $(PROJECT_DIR)/core/target/release/libframejob_core.a
    # The graphics reference (road map 10's G4a): `graphic_reference` reads
    # GraphicsAPI.md, and a package's graphics/ gets both as API.md and
    # API.d.ts. Copied under new names, so not a resources-phase entry.
    postBuildScripts:
      - name: Copy Graphics Reference
        script: |
          set -e
          dest="$TARGET_BUILD_DIR/$UNLOCALIZED_RESOURCES_FOLDER_PATH"
          mkdir -p "$dest"
          cp "$PROJECT_DIR/docs/graphics-api.md" "$dest/GraphicsAPI.md"
          cp "$PROJECT_DIR/docs/graphics-api.d.ts" "$dest/GraphicsAPI.d.ts"
        inputFiles:
          - $(PROJECT_DIR)/docs/graphics-api.md
          - $(PROJECT_DIR)/docs/graphics-api.d.ts
        outputFiles:
          - $(TARGET_BUILD_DIR)/$(UNLOCALIZED_RESOURCES_FOLDER_PATH)/GraphicsAPI.md
          - $(TARGET_BUILD_DIR)/$(UNLOCALIZED_RESOURCES_FOLDER_PATH)/GraphicsAPI.d.ts
      # The graphic templates (road map 10's G5b): Insert ▸ Graphic lists the
      # six modules of graphic/tests/graphics/, copied as they are.
      - name: Copy Graphic Templates
        script: |
          set -e
          dest="$TARGET_BUILD_DIR/$UNLOCALIZED_RESOURCES_FOLDER_PATH/GraphicTemplates"
          mkdir -p "$dest"
          cp "$PROJECT_DIR"/graphic/tests/graphics/*.js "$dest/"
        inputFiles:
          - $(PROJECT_DIR)/graphic/tests/graphics/bar-chart.js
          - $(PROJECT_DIR)/graphic/tests/graphics/callout.js
          - $(PROJECT_DIR)/graphic/tests/graphics/counter.js
          - $(PROJECT_DIR)/graphic/tests/graphics/kinetic-type.js
          - $(PROJECT_DIR)/graphic/tests/graphics/lower-third.js
          - $(PROJECT_DIR)/graphic/tests/graphics/title-card.js
        outputFiles:
          - $(TARGET_BUILD_DIR)/$(UNLOCALIZED_RESOURCES_FOLDER_PATH)/GraphicTemplates/bar-chart.js
          - $(TARGET_BUILD_DIR)/$(UNLOCALIZED_RESOURCES_FOLDER_PATH)/GraphicTemplates/callout.js
          - $(TARGET_BUILD_DIR)/$(UNLOCALIZED_RESOURCES_FOLDER_PATH)/GraphicTemplates/counter.js
          - $(TARGET_BUILD_DIR)/$(UNLOCALIZED_RESOURCES_FOLDER_PATH)/GraphicTemplates/kinetic-type.js
          - $(TARGET_BUILD_DIR)/$(UNLOCALIZED_RESOURCES_FOLDER_PATH)/GraphicTemplates/lower-third.js
          - $(TARGET_BUILD_DIR)/$(UNLOCALIZED_RESOURCES_FOLDER_PATH)/GraphicTemplates/title-card.js
      # The encoders' licence and patent texts (spec §11 CX-5 (4), #376):
      # build/codecs/licenses/<library>/ as Build Codecs installed them, into
      # Contents/Resources/Licenses/ (tools/proof/dist_check.py D40/D41).
      - name: Copy Codec Licences
        basedOnDependencyAnalysis: false
        script: |
          set -e
          dest="$TARGET_BUILD_DIR/$UNLOCALIZED_RESOURCES_FOLDER_PATH/Licenses"
          rm -rf "$dest"
          mkdir -p "$dest"
          cp -R "$PROJECT_DIR"/build/codecs/licenses/* "$dest/"
      # The assistant's agent helper (agent/, spec §11 AI-1): compiled with
      # Bun, placed in Contents/Helpers and signed by agent/build.sh, before
      # Xcode signs the app around it — the app's own signature does not
      # cover a nested executable. Without bun it fails; it never skips.
      - name: Build Agent Helper
        # Bun rebuilds the helper in well under a second, so it runs every build.
        basedOnDependencyAnalysis: false
        script: /bin/sh "$PROJECT_DIR/agent/build.sh" helper
      # The stdio MCP server external clients start (road map 14's MC3, spec
      # §11 MC-3): mcp-proxy/ built by cargo, put in Contents/Helpers beside the
      # assistant's helper and signed as agent/build.sh signs that one (the
      # hardened runtime, no entitlements), before Xcode signs the app.
      - name: Build MCP Proxy
        basedOnDependencyAnalysis: false
        script: |
          set -e
          export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"
          cd "$PROJECT_DIR/mcp-proxy"
          cargo build --release
          HELPERS="$TARGET_BUILD_DIR/$CONTENTS_FOLDER_PATH/Helpers"
          mkdir -p "$HELPERS"
          cp "$PROJECT_DIR/mcp-proxy/target/release/framejob-mcp" "$HELPERS/"
          IDENTITY="${EXPANDED_CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY:--}"
          TIMESTAMP=""
          if [ "$IDENTITY" != "-" ]; then TIMESTAMP="--timestamp"; fi
          codesign --force --options runtime $TIMESTAMP \
            --sign "$IDENTITY" "$HELPERS/framejob-mcp"
      # The catalog snapshot framejob-mcp lists from while no Frame Job runs
      # (MC-4; MC1 q1): the just-linked executable, ad-hoc signed alone in place
      # because the linker leaves it unsigned and arm64 kills an unsigned exec,
      # run with -RCWriteCatalog (AgentCatalogSnapshot.swift), then the bundle
      # signed again as Xcode's CodeSign signs it. It fails on a non-zero exit
      # and on any `Frame Job: ` line, the parity check complaining.
      - name: Write Agent Catalog
        basedOnDependencyAnalysis: false
        script: |
          set -e
          out="$TARGET_BUILD_DIR/$UNLOCALIZED_RESOURCES_FOLDER_PATH/agent-catalog.json"
          exe="$TARGET_BUILD_DIR/$EXECUTABLE_PATH"
          # The codesign below re-seals the bundle, writing the marker
          # tools/proof/proof_app.py reads as a complete build; any failure
          # from here on removes it, so a failed build is refused (B88).
          marker="$TARGET_BUILD_DIR/$CONTENTS_FOLDER_PATH/_CodeSignature/CodeResources"
          trap 'rm -f "$marker"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$(dirname "$out")"
          codesign -s - -f "$exe"
          rc=0
          output=$("$exe" -RCWriteCatalog "$out" 2>&1) || rc=$?
          if [ -n "$output" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$output"; fi
          if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "error: the catalog writer exited $rc"
            exit 1
          fi
          if printf '%s\n' "$output" | grep -q 'Frame Job: '; then
            echo "error: the catalog writer's output holds the parity check's complaint"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Xcode's CodeSign task does not see this step change the bundle, so
          # a build where nothing else changed skips it and would ship the
          # ad-hoc signature above (no entitlements) over a catalog written
          # after it. Seal the bundle as that task does: its identity and its
          # processed entitlements (B88; a second no-op `make dist` failed D14).
          IDENTITY="${EXPANDED_CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY:--}"
          TIMESTAMP="--timestamp=none"
          if [ "$IDENTITY" != "-" ]; then TIMESTAMP="--timestamp"; fi
          RUNTIME=""
          if [ "$ENABLE_HARDENED_RUNTIME" = YES ]; then RUNTIME="-o runtime"; fi
          codesign --force --sign "$IDENTITY" $RUNTIME $TIMESTAMP \
            --entitlements "$TARGET_TEMP_DIR/$FULL_PRODUCT_NAME.xcent" \
            --generate-entitlement-der "$CODESIGNING_FOLDER_PATH"
          trap - EXIT
        inputFiles:
          # Ordering only (the step runs every build): the entitlements it
          # signs with, and the Info.plist its seal covers.
          - $(TARGET_TEMP_DIR)/$(FULL_PRODUCT_NAME).xcent
          - $(TARGET_BUILD_DIR)/$(INFOPLIST_PATH)

schemes:
  FrameJob:
    build:
      targets:
        FrameJob: all
    run:
      config: Release
    # Product > Archive never ships the dev tools.
    archive:
      config: Distribution

toolUseResult.stdout:
name: FrameJob
options:
  bundleIdPrefix: com.kgalligan
  deploymentTarget:
    macOS: "26.0"
  createIntermediateGroups: true

# Distribution is Release without FRAMEJOB_DEV_TOOLS (spec §11 V-1): `make dist`
# builds it and checks the binary; Debug and Release carry the dev tools.
configs:
  Debug: debug
  Release: release
  Distribution: release

# Sparkle 2, the published build's updater (spec §11 PUB-6..PUB-9). xcodegen
# links a package per target, not per configuration, so Sparkle.framework is
# embedded in every configuration but loaded only in Distribution (PUB-7):
# Debug and Release drop its load command (`-dead_strip_dylibs` below); only
# Distribution compiles code that uses it (FRAMEJOB_UPDATER below) and holds a
# feed and a key. The first build fetches the package over the network.
packages:
  Sparkle:
    url: https://github.com/sparkle-project/Sparkle
    exactVersion: "2.10.1"

targets:
  FrameJob:
    type: application
    platform: macOS
    sources:
      - path: app/Sources
      - path: app/Assets.xcassets
      - path: app/Resources/Fonts
        type: folder
        buildPhase: resources
      - path: app/Resources/Models
        type: folder
        buildPhase: resources
      # A one-frame 16x16 black movie. A timeline of nothing but text, shapes
      # and images owns no composition track, and AVFoundation gives a
      # composition of empty edits a duration of ZERO — so nothing renders
      # offline. This is the minimum real content that gives such a project a
      # track to tick against; the compositor never samples it.
      - path: app/Resources/Blank.mp4
        buildPhase: resources
      # 10 s of ALAC digital silence, 48 kHz stereo (spec §11 #336). An audio
      # track whose every clip has no source is nothing but empty edits, which
      # an export cannot read; this fills it back to back with real silence.
      - path: app/Resources/Silence.caf
        buildPhase: resources
      - path: app/Resources/Shaders
        buildPhase: sources
    # Sparkle (spec §11 PUB-7): embedded in every configuration, loaded only
    # in Distribution.
    dependencies:
      - package: Sparkle
    settings:
      base:
        PRODUCT_NAME: "Frame Job"
        # The module NSDocumentClass names, the same in every configuration: a
        # PRODUCT_NAME with a space would derive Frame_Job (spec §11 NM-3).
        PRODUCT_MODULE_NAME: FrameJob
        # The Rust core is built for the host arch only; for a universal app,
        # cargo-build both targets and lipo them, then widen this.
        ARCHS: arm64
        SWIFT_VERSION: "5.0"
        ASSETCATALOG_COMPILER_APPICON_NAME: AppIcon
        SWIFT_OBJC_BRIDGING_HEADER: app/Bridging/FrameJob-Bridging-Header.h
        LIBRARY_SEARCH_PATHS:
          - $(PROJECT_DIR)/core/target/release
        # The bundled encoders (spec §11 CX-4, CX-5): their headers for the
        # bridging header, and their two static archives linked by full path
        # (never -l, so no codec dylib can ever be picked instead) in this list
        # and in Debug's and Release's, which replace it; Distribution inherits it.
        HEADER_SEARCH_PATHS:
          - $(PROJECT_DIR)/build/codecs/include
        OTHER_LDFLAGS:
          - -lframejob_core
          - $(PROJECT_DIR)/build/codecs/lib/libSvtAv1Enc.a
          - $(PROJECT_DIR)/build/codecs/lib/libvpx.a
        MTL_LANGUAGE_REVISION: UseDeploymentTarget
        ENABLE_USER_SCRIPT_SANDBOXING: "NO"
        ENABLE_HARDENED_RUNTIME: "YES"
        CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY: "-"
        CODE_SIGN_STYLE: Manual
        DEVELOPMENT_TEAM: ""
        MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: "26.0"
        # The base version lives in VERSION (spec §11 PUB-2), as Rasterize's
        # does; `make project` exports it as RC_BASE_VERSION (a bare `xcodegen
        # generate` leaves it blank). Local builds read "0.2 (0)"; the publish
        # workflow overrides both settings with "<base>.<run number>" and the
        # run number.
        MARKETING_VERSION: ${RC_BASE_VERSION}
        CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION: "0"
      # The dev-tools seam (AgentServer+DevTools.swift) compiles only under this
      # condition; `$(inherited)` keeps the project-level DEBUG in Debug.
      configs:
        Debug:
          SWIFT_ACTIVE_COMPILATION_CONDITIONS: "$(inherited) FRAMEJOB_DEV_TOOLS"
          # Sparkle is never loaded here (spec §11 PUB-7): no Debug code
          # references it, so the linker drops its load command. Loaded, dyld
          # refuses an ad-hoc framework under the hardened runtime's library
          # validation ("different Team IDs") and the app cannot launch. A
          # per-config OTHER_LDFLAGS replaces the base one, so the core is
          # restated, and so are the encoders' archives (CX-4).
          OTHER_LDFLAGS:
            - -lframejob_core
            - $(PROJECT_DIR)/build/codecs/lib/libSvtAv1Enc.a
            - $(PROJECT_DIR)/build/codecs/lib/libvpx.a
            - -Xlinker
            - -dead_strip_dylibs
          # Xcode 26 splits a Debug executable into a stub and __preview.dylib,
          # and Write Agent Catalog's `codesign -s - -f "$exe"` fails on the split.
          ENABLE_DEBUG_DYLIB: "NO"
          # The Debug build is its own app (spec §11 V-5, NM-3): "Frame Job
          # Debug", its own bundle id and defaults domain, and an Alternate
          # `.framejob` handler, so a double-click opens the real Frame Job.
          # Info.plist reads PRODUCT_NAME for both names and the RC_ setting
          # through `:default=`, so Release and Distribution, which take the
          # base PRODUCT_NAME and leave the handler rank unset, keep theirs.
          PRODUCT_NAME: "Frame Job Debug"
          PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER: com.kgalligan.FrameJob.debug
          RC_PROJECT_HANDLER_RANK: Alternate
        Release:
          SWIFT_ACTIVE_COMPILATION_CONDITIONS: "$(inherited) FRAMEJOB_DEV_TOOLS"
          # As Debug's: Sparkle embedded, never loaded (spec §11 PUB-7;
          # tools/proof/dist_check.py D35 holds it). The encoders' archives
          # restated as Debug's are (CX-4).
          OTHER_LDFLAGS:
            - -lframejob_core
            - $(PROJECT_DIR)/build/codecs/lib/libSvtAv1Enc.a
            - $(PROJECT_DIR)/build/codecs/lib/libvpx.a
            - -Xlinker
            - -dead_strip_dylibs
        # Distribution is the build that ships (spec §11 V-1), and notarization
        # refuses the get-task-allow Xcode injects by default, so it is signed
        # with `entitlements` alone (#145, tools/proof/dist_check.py D14).
        Distribution:
          CODE_SIGN_INJECT_BASE_ENTITLEMENTS: "NO"
          # The updater (spec §11 PUB-6..PUB-9) is Distribution's alone:
          # AppDelegate+Updates.swift compiles only under FRAMEJOB_UPDATER, and
          # Info.plist reads the feed and the EdDSA public key through
          # `:default=` (V-5's pattern), so Debug and Release hold neither.
          # The public key is the owner's (PUB-8); until it lands it is empty
          # and dist_check.py's D31 and published_check.py's P20 refuse it.
          SWIFT_ACTIVE_COMPILATION_CONDITIONS: "$(inherited) FRAMEJOB_UPDATER"
          RC_SPARKLE_FEED_URL: https://github.com/kpgalligan/framejob/releases/latest/download/appcast.xml
          RC_SPARKLE_PUBLIC_KEY: ""
    info:
      path: app/Info.plist
      properties:
        CFBundleName: "$(PRODUCT_NAME)"
        CFBundleDisplayName: "$(PRODUCT_NAME)"
        CFBundleShortVersionString: $(MARKETING_VERSION)
        CFBundleVersion: $(CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION)
        LSMinimumSystemVersion: "26.0"
        LSApplicationCategoryType: public.app-category.video
        NSPrincipalClass: NSApplication
        NSHighResolutionCapable: true
        ATSApplicationFontsPath: Fonts
        NSHumanReadableCopyright: ""
        # Sparkle's feed and EdDSA public key (spec §11 PUB-6, PUB-8): set in
        # Distribution alone, empty in Debug and Release (PUB-7). No
        # SUEnableAutomaticChecks and no SUAutomaticallyUpdate: Sparkle's own
        # defaults apply (PUB-9).
        SUFeedURL: "$(RC_SPARKLE_FEED_URL:default=)"
        SUPublicEDKey: "$(RC_SPARKLE_PUBLIC_KEY:default=)"
        # File ▸ New Recording… (road map 3, R1c) — the microphone half of a
        # recording, which speech never needed (the speech engine reads an
        # extracted file). The microphone takes TWO things, and this key is one:
        # NSMicrophoneUsageDescription, or AVCaptureDevice.requestAccess and
        # the first AVCaptureDeviceInput CRASH the app; and under the hardened
        # runtime the entitlement com.apple.security.device.audio-input
        # (`entitlements` below), without which the grant is refused however
        # the person answers the prompt. Screen Recording has neither key nor
        # entitlement: its prompt is triggered by the first capture or by
        # CGRequestScreenCaptureAccess().
        NSMicrophoneUsageDescription:
          Frame Job records the microphone you choose alongside a screen recording, into
          a file of its own beside the movie. Nothing is sent anywhere.
        # The camera half of a recording (camera-recording CR1a, spec §11 CAM-3)
        # takes the same two things as the microphone: this key, without which
        # AVCaptureDevice.requestAccess(for: .video) and the first camera
        # AVCaptureDeviceInput CRASH the app, and the entitlement
        # com.apple.security.device.camera (`entitlements` below). No
        # NSCameraUseContinuityCameraDeviceType: CR0's D2 listed the iPhone's
        # Continuity Camera without it.
        NSCameraUsageDescription:
          Frame Job records the camera you choose, into a file of its own. Nothing is
          sent anywhere.
        UTExportedTypeDeclarations:
          - UTTypeIdentifier: com.kgalligan.framejob-project
            UTTypeDescription: Frame Job Project
            UTTypeConformsTo: [com.apple.package]
            UTTypeTagSpecification:
              public.filename-extension: [framejob]
        CFBundleDocumentTypes:
          - CFBundleTypeName: Frame Job Project
            LSItemContentTypes: [com.kgalligan.framejob-project]
            CFBundleTypeRole: Editor
            NSDocumentClass: FrameJob.ProjectDocument
            LSTypeIsPackage: true
            LSHandlerRank: "$(RC_PROJECT_HANDLER_RANK:default=Owner)"
          # Opening a media file makes an UNTITLED project sized to it with
          # the file as the first clip (spec 1) — the app is an Alternate
          # handler for each so Open With… works from the Finder.
          - CFBundleTypeName: QuickTime Movie
            LSItemContentTypes: [com.apple.quicktime-movie]
            CFBundleTypeRole: Editor
            NSDocumentClass: FrameJob.ProjectDocument
            LSHandlerRank: Alternate
          - CFBundleTypeName: MPEG-4 Movie
            LSItemContentTypes: [public.mpeg-4, com.apple.m4v-video]
            CFBundleTypeRole: Editor
            NSDocumentClass: FrameJob.ProjectDocument
            LSHandlerRank: Alternate
          - CFBundleTypeName: Movie
            LSItemContentTypes: [public.movie]
            CFBundleTypeRole: Editor
            NSDocumentClass: FrameJob.ProjectDocument
            LSHandlerRank: Alternate
          - CFBundleTypeName: Audio
            LSItemContentTypes:
              [com.apple.m4a-audio, public.mp3, com.microsoft.waveform-audio, public.aiff-audio]
            CFBundleTypeRole: Editor
            NSDocumentClass: FrameJob.ProjectDocument
            LSHandlerRank: Alternate
          - CFBundleTypeName: Image
            LSItemContentTypes: [public.png, public.jpeg, public.heic]
            CFBundleTypeRole: Editor
            NSDocumentClass: FrameJob.ProjectDocument
            LSHandlerRank: Alternate

    # second surprise: a bare swiftc probe never needs it, the signed app
    # does), and the camera's, added on that finding (spec §11 CAM-3: CR0

    # GENERATED by xcodegen from these properties, like app/Info.plist, and
    # git-ignored beside it.

      path: app/FrameJob.entitlements

        basedOnDependencyAnalysis: false

          set -e

          - $(PROJECT_DIR)/build/codecs/lib/libvpx.a

          # `make rust` builds first; an archive on a fresh checkout does.

          cd "$PROJECT_DIR/core"
          # Xcode exports MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET and SDKROOT, a shell's
          # `make rust` neither, and rquickjs-sys's build script reruns when
          # MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET changes: with them set, the shell build

          # a tree copy's step (its `core` is a symlink) rewrote the tree's
          # core/target (#225). Unset, both builds are the same build.

    # The graphics reference (road map 10's G4a): `graphic_reference` reads

        script: |

          cp "$PROJECT_DIR/docs/graphics-api.d.ts" "$dest/GraphicsAPI.d.ts"
        inputFiles:
          - $(PROJECT_DIR)/docs/graphics-api.md
          - $(PROJECT_DIR)/docs/graphics-api.d.ts
        outputFiles:
          - $(TARGET_BUILD_DIR)/$(UNLOCALIZED_RESOURCES_FOLDER_PATH)/GraphicsAPI.md
          - $(TARGET_BUILD_DIR)/$(UNLOCALIZED_RESOURCES_FOLDER_PATH)/GraphicsAPI.d.ts
      # The graphic templates (road map 10's G5b): Insert ▸ Graphic lists the

      - name: Copy Graphic Templates
        script: |

          dest="$TARGET_BUILD_DIR/$UNLOCALIZED_RESOURCES_FOLDER_PATH/GraphicTemplates"
          mkdir -p "$dest"
          cp "$PROJECT_DIR"/graphic/tests/graphics/*.js "$dest/"
        inputFiles:

          - $(PROJECT_DIR)/graphic/tests/graphics/callout.js
          - $(PROJECT_DIR)/graphic/tests/graphics/counter.js
          - $(PROJECT_DIR)/graphic/tests/graphics/kinetic-type.js
          - $(PROJECT_DIR)/graphic/tests/graphics/lower-third.js
          - $(PROJECT_DIR)/graphic/tests/graphics/title-card.js
        outputFiles:
          - $(TARGET_BUILD_DIR)/$(UNLOCALIZED_RESOURCES_FOLDER_PATH)/GraphicTemplates/bar-chart.js
          - $(TARGET_BUILD_DIR)/$(UNLOCALIZED_RESOURCES_FOLDER_PATH)/GraphicTemplates/callout.js
          - $(TARGET_BUILD_DIR)/$(UNLOCALIZED_RESOURCES_FOLDER_PATH)/GraphicTemplates/counter.js

          - $(TARGET_BUILD_DIR)/$(UNLOCALIZED_RESOURCES_FOLDER_PATH)/GraphicTemplates/lower-third.js

      # cover a nested executable. Without bun it fails; it never skips.
      - name: Build Agent Helper

        basedOnDependencyAnalysis: false
        script: /bin/sh "$PROJECT_DIR/agent/build.sh" helper

      # §11 MC-3): mcp-proxy/ built by cargo, put in Contents/Helpers beside the
      # assistant's helper and signed as agent/build.sh signs that one (the
      # hardened runtime, no entitlements), before Xcode signs the app.
      - name: Build MCP Proxy
        basedOnDependencyAnalysis: false
        script: |
          set -e
          export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"

          mkdir -p "$HELPERS"
          cp "$PROJECT_DIR/mcp-proxy/target/release/framejob-mcp" "$HELPERS/"
          IDENTITY="${EXPANDED_CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY:--}"
          TIMESTAMP=""
          if [ "$IDENTITY" != "-" ]; then TIMESTAMP="--timestamp"; fi
          codesign --force --options runtime $TIMESTAMP \
            --sign "$IDENTITY" "$HELPERS/framejob-mcp"
      # The catalog snapshot framejob-mcp lists from while no Frame Job runs
      # (MC-4; MC1 q1): the just-linked executable, ad-hoc signed alone in place

      # run with -RCWriteCatalog (AgentCatalogSnapshot.swift), then the bundle
      # signed again as Xcode's CodeSign signs it. It fails on a non-zero exit
      # and on any `Frame Job: ` line, the parity check complaining.
      - name: Write Agent Catalog
        basedOnDependencyAnalysis: false
        script: |
          set -e

          exe="$TARGET_BUILD_DIR/$EXECUTABLE_PATH"
          # The codesign below re-seals the bundle, writing the marker
          # tools/proof/proof_app.py reads as a complete build; any failure
          # from here on removes it, so a failed build is refused (B88).
          marker="$TARGET_BUILD_DIR/$CONTENTS_FOLDER_PATH/_CodeSignature/CodeResources"

            echo "error: the catalog writer exited $rc"
            exit 1
          fi
          if printf '%s\n' "$output" | grep -q 'Frame Job: '; then
            echo "error: the catalog writer's output holds the parity check's complaint"

          fi
          # Xcode's CodeSign task does not see this step change the bundle, so
          # a build where nothing else changed skips it and would ship the
          # ad-hoc signature above (no entitlements) over a catalog written
          # after it. Seal the bundle as that task does: its identity and its
          # processed entitlements (B88; a second no-op `make dist` failed D14).
          IDENTITY="${EXPANDED_CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY:--}"
          TIMESTAMP="--timestamp=none"
          if [ "$IDENTITY" != "-" ]; then TIMESTAMP="--timestamp"; fi
          RUNTIME=""
          if [ "$ENABLE_HARDENED_RUNTIME" = YES ]; then RUNTIME="-o runtime"; fi
          codesign --force --sign "$IDENTITY" $RUNTIME $TIMESTAMP \
            --entitlements "$TARGET_TEMP_DIR/$FULL_PRODUCT_NAME.xcent" \
            --generate-entitlement-der "$CODESIGNING_FOLDER_PATH"
          trap - EXIT

          # signs with, and the Info.plist its seal covers.
          - $(TARGET_TEMP_DIR)/$(FULL_PRODUCT_NAME).xcent
          - $(TARGET_BUILD_DIR)/$(INFOPLIST_PATH)

content.content:
# Builds, signs (Developer ID), notarizes and publishes FrameJob.dmg as a
# GitHub Release on every push to the `publish` branch (spec §11 PUB-1..PUB-9).
# Rasterize's workflow, renamed, with three differences: the archive is the
# Distribution configuration (no dev tools, spec §11 V-1), the Metal toolchain
# is checked for, and the exported app is checked by
# tools/proof/published_check.py before it is packed. Beside the DMG goes a
# one-item appcast.xml, the stapled DMG's EdDSA signature in it, which every
# installed copy's Sparkle reads from the latest release (spec §11
# PUB-6..PUB-9, tools/proof/appcast.py).
#
# Version: "<VERSION file>.<run number>", build number = run number. The run
# counter belongs to this file — renaming or recreating it restarts numbering,
# so leave the name alone. A re-run keeps its run number and replaces the
# release's DMG and appcast rather than failing, and leaves Latest alone; a
# run that creates an older release than the current Latest creates it with
# --latest=false, so Latest is always the highest run number (PUB-6).
#
# Secrets (in the `publish` environment, restricted to the `publish` branch):
#   DEVELOPER_ID_P12_BASE64, DEVELOPER_ID_P12_PASSWORD, KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD,
#   APPLE_TEAM_ID, ASC_KEY_ID, ASC_ISSUER_ID, ASC_KEY_P8_BASE64,
#   SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY (the owner's EdDSA private key, `generate_keys -x`
#   output, spec §11 PUB-8; the first step fails without it)
name: Publish

on:
  push:
    branches: [publish]

concurrency:
  group: publish
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: macos-26
    environment: publish
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      # Nothing ships unsigned (spec §11 PUB-8): without the update key the run
      # stops here, before anything is built or signed.
      - name: Check the update key
        env:
          SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY }}
        run: |
          if ! [ -n "$SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY" ]; then
            echo "::error::The publish environment has no SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY secret (spec §11 PUB-8)"
            exit 1
          fi

      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Toolchain
        run: |
          xcodebuild -version
          rustup toolchain install stable --profile minimal
          rustup default stable
          rustc --version
          brew install xcodegen
          # The bundled encoders (spec §11 CX-5): Xcode's "Build Codecs" step
          # fetches the pinned tarballs and builds them with cmake, which a
          # runner image may or may not carry; the system perl is enough.
          command -v cmake >/dev/null || brew install cmake
          cmake --version
          # Compositor.metal is compiled by the build, and Xcode 26 ships the
          # Metal toolchain as a separate component an image may not carry.
          if ! xcrun metal --version > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            xcodebuild -downloadComponent MetalToolchain
          fi
          xcrun metal --version

      # Builds the assistant's agent helper (agent/) in the Xcode post-build step.
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2

      # core/ builds graphic/ as a path dependency; mcp-proxy/ is framejob-mcp.
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          workspaces: |
            core
            mcp-proxy

      - name: Compute paths and version
        run: |
          # The runner context isn't available in job-level env, so the paths
          # under RUNNER_TEMP are exported here for the later steps.
          {
            echo "KEYCHAIN=$RUNNER_TEMP/signing.keychain-db"
            echo "ARCHIVE=$RUNNER_TEMP/FrameJob.xcarchive"
            echo "EXPORT=$RUNNER_TEMP/export"
            echo "DMG=$RUNNER_TEMP/FrameJob.dmg"
            echo "APPCAST=$RUNNER_TEMP/appcast.xml"
            echo "ED_KEY=$RUNNER_TEMP/sparkle_ed_key"
          } >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          BASE="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < VERSION)"
          # macOS versions are at most three integers; the run number is the third.
          if ! [[ "$BASE" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
            echo "::error::VERSION must be MAJOR.MINOR, got '$BASE'"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "VERSION=$BASE.$GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "BUILD_NUMBER=$GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Import signing certificate
        env:
          P12_BASE64: ${{ secrets.DEVELOPER_ID_P12_BASE64 }}
          P12_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.DEVELOPER_ID_P12_PASSWORD }}
          KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          P12="$RUNNER_TEMP/cert.p12"
          echo "$P12_BASE64" | base64 --decode > "$P12"
          security create-keychain -p "$KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD" "$KEYCHAIN"
          security set-keychain-settings -lut 21600 "$KEYCHAIN"
          security unlock-keychain -p "$KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD" "$KEYCHAIN"
          security import "$P12" -P "$P12_PASSWORD" -A -t cert -f pkcs12 -k "$KEYCHAIN"
          security set-key-partition-list -S apple-tool:,apple:,codesign: -s -k "$KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD" "$KEYCHAIN" > /dev/null
          # Put the signing keychain in the search list so xcodebuild and codesign find it.
          # The existing entries are split on purpose; runner keychain paths have no spaces.
          # shellcheck disable=SC2046
          security list-keychains -d user -s "$KEYCHAIN" $(security list-keychains -d user | tr -d '"')
          rm "$P12"
          security find-identity -v -p codesigning "$KEYCHAIN"

      # Distribution is the configuration that ships (spec §11 V-1): Release
      # without FRAMEJOB_DEV_TOOLS, and without the get-task-allow notarization
      # refuses. The two helpers are signed by their own build steps with the
      # identity given here, before Xcode signs the app around them.
      - name: Archive
        env:
          TEAM_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLE_TEAM_ID }}
        run: |
          make project
          xcodebuild archive \
            -project FrameJob.xcodeproj -scheme FrameJob -configuration Distribution \
            -destination 'generic/platform=macOS' \
            -derivedDataPath build \
            -archivePath "$ARCHIVE" \
            CODE_SIGN_STYLE=Manual \
            CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="Developer ID Application" \
            DEVELOPMENT_TEAM="$TEAM_ID" \
            OTHER_CODE_SIGN_FLAGS=--timestamp \
            MARKETING_VERSION="$VERSION" \
            CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION="$BUILD_NUMBER"

      # published_check.py holds what notarization does not look at: no dev
      # tools, each binary's exact entitlements after the export's re-sign, the
      # catalog snapshot, the two version numbers, and the updater: Sparkle's
      # framework and helpers signed with the app's team and the hardened
      # runtime, the feed and a 32-byte EdDSA public key (spec §11 PUB-6..PUB-8).
      - name: Export
        run: |
          xcodebuild -exportArchive \
            -archivePath "$ARCHIVE" \
            -exportOptionsPlist .github/ExportOptions.plist \
            -exportPath "$EXPORT"
          APP="$EXPORT/Frame Job.app"
          codesign --verify --deep --strict --verbose=2 "$APP"
          codesign -dvv "$APP" 2>&1 | grep -E '^(Authority|TeamIdentifier|Timestamp|Runtime)'
          python3 tools/proof/published_check.py --app "$APP" \
            --version "$VERSION" --build "$BUILD_NUMBER"

      - name: Build DMG
        run: |
          STAGE="$RUNNER_TEMP/dmg"
          mkdir -p "$STAGE"
          cp -R "$EXPORT/Frame Job.app" "$STAGE/"
          ln -s /Applications "$STAGE/Applications"
          # hdiutil's own estimate of the scratch volume from -srcfolder now
          # and then comes out short ("No space left on device" copying the
          # helper), so the size is the staged folder's plus a quarter and
          # 64 MB; UDZO compresses the free space away.
          SIZE_MB=$(( $(du -sm "$STAGE" | cut -f1) * 5 / 4 + 64 ))
          hdiutil create -volname "Frame Job" -srcfolder "$STAGE" -size "${SIZE_MB}m" -ov -format UDZO "$DMG"
          codesign --sign "Developer ID Application" --timestamp --keychain "$KEYCHAIN" "$DMG"

      - name: Notarize
        env:
          ASC_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.ASC_KEY_ID }}
          ASC_ISSUER_ID: ${{ secrets.ASC_ISSUER_ID }}
          ASC_KEY_P8_BASE64: ${{ secrets.ASC_KEY_P8_BASE64 }}
        run: |
          KEY="$RUNNER_TEMP/AuthKey.p8"
          echo "$ASC_KEY_P8_BASE64" | base64 --decode > "$KEY"
          AUTH=(--key "$KEY" --key-id "$ASC_KEY_ID" --issuer "$ASC_ISSUER_ID")
          OUT="$(xcrun notarytool submit "$DMG" "${AUTH[@]}" --wait --timeout 30m --output-format json)"
          echo "$OUT"
          ID="$(jq -r .id <<< "$OUT")"
          STATUS="$(jq -r .status <<< "$OUT")"
          if [ "$STATUS" != "Accepted" ]; then
            xcrun notarytool log "$ID" "${AUTH[@]}" || true
            echo "::error::Notarization finished with status '$STATUS'"
            exit 1
          fi
          xcrun stapler staple "$DMG"
          xcrun stapler validate "$DMG"
          spctl --assess --type open --context context:primary-signature --verbose=2 "$DMG"

      # The EdDSA signature is made over the stapled DMG, the bytes the release
      # serves (spec §11 PUB-8). sign_update is the Sparkle package's own, from
      # the archive's package resolution; the key reaches it only as a 0600
      # file, removed straight after (and by the clean-up step on a failure).
      - name: Sign the update and write the appcast
        env:
          SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY }}
        run: |
          COUNT="$(find build/SourcePackages/artifacts -path '*/bin/sign_update' -type f | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
          if [ "$COUNT" != 1 ]; then
            echo "::error::Expected one sign_update under build/SourcePackages/artifacts, found $COUNT"
            exit 1
          fi
          SIGN_UPDATE="$(find build/SourcePackages/artifacts -path '*/bin/sign_update' -type f)"
          umask 077; printf '%s' "$SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY" > "$ED_KEY"
          python3 tools/proof/appcast.py write \
            --app "$EXPORT/Frame Job.app" \
            --dmg "$DMG" \
            --sign-update "$SIGN_UPDATE" \
            --key-file "$ED_KEY" \
            --url "https://github.com/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/download/v$VERSION/FrameJob.dmg" \
            --notes-url "https://github.com/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/tag/v$VERSION" \
            --out "$APPCAST"
          rm -f "$ED_KEY"

      - name: Publish release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          TAG="v$VERSION"
          if gh release view "$TAG" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            # A re-run: both assets replaced, Latest left alone (spec §11 PUB-6).
            gh release upload "$TAG" "$DMG" "$APPCAST" --clobber
          else
            # The feed is releases/latest/download/appcast.xml, so Latest is
            # always the highest run number (spec §11 PUB-6): a release older
            # than the current Latest (an old run re-run) is not made Latest.
            LATEST="$(gh release view --json tagName -q .tagName 2>/dev/null || true)"
            MAKE_LATEST="--latest"
            if [ -n "$LATEST" ] && [ "${LATEST##*.}" -gt "$GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER" ] 2> /dev/null; then
              MAKE_LATEST="--latest=false"
            fi
            gh release create "$TAG" "$DMG" "$APPCAST" \
              --target "$GITHUB_SHA" \
              --title "Frame Job $VERSION" \
              --generate-notes \
              "$MAKE_LATEST"
          fi

      - name: Clean up signing material
        if: always()
        run: |
          security delete-keychain "$KEYCHAIN" 2> /dev/null || true
          rm -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/cert.p12" "$RUNNER_TEMP/AuthKey.p8" "$ED_KEY"

          OUT="$(xcrun notarytool submit "$DMG" "${AUTH[@]}" --wait --timeout 30m --output-format json)"
          echo "$OUT"
          ID="$(jq -r .id <<< "$OUT")"
          STATUS="$(jq -r .status <<< "$OUT")"
          if [ "$STATUS" != "Accepted" ]; then
            xcrun notarytool log "$ID" "${AUTH[@]}" || true
            echo "::error::Notarization finished with status '$STATUS'"
            exit 1
          fi
          xcrun stapler staple "$DMG"
          xcrun stapler validate "$DMG"
          spctl --assess --type open --context context:primary-signature --verbose=2 "$DMG"

      # The EdDSA signature is made over the stapled DMG, the bytes the release
      # serves (spec §11 PUB-8). sign_update is the Sparkle package's own, from
      # the archive's package resolution; the key reaches it only as a 0600
      # file, removed straight after (and by the clean-up step on a failure).
      - name: Sign the update and write the appcast
        env:
          SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY }}
        run: |
          COUNT="$(find build/SourcePackages/artifacts -path '*/bin/sign_update' -type f | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
          if [ "$COUNT" != 1 ]; then
            echo "::error::Expected one sign_update under build/SourcePackages/artifacts, found $COUNT"
            exit 1
          fi
          SIGN_UPDATE="$(find build/SourcePackages/artifacts -path '*/bin/sign_update' -type f)"
          umask 077; printf '%s' "$SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY" > "$ED_KEY"
          python3 tools/proof/appcast.py write \
            --app "$EXPORT/Frame Job.app" \
            --dmg "$DMG" \
            --sign-update "$SIGN_UPDATE" \
            --key-file "$ED_KEY" \
            --url "https://github.com/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/download/v$VERSION/FrameJob.dmg" \
            --notes-url "https://github.com/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/tag/v$VERSION" \
            --out "$APPCAST"
          rm -f "$ED_KEY"

      - name: Publish release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          TAG="v$VERSION"
          if gh release view "$TAG" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            # A re-run: both assets replaced, Latest left alone (spec §11 PUB-6).
            gh release upload "$TAG" "$DMG" "$APPCAST" --clobber
          else
            # The feed is releases/latest/download/appcast.xml, so Latest is
            # always the highest run number (spec §11 PUB-6): a release older
            # than the current Latest (an old run re-run) is not made Latest.
            LATEST="$(gh release view --json tagName -q .tagName 2>/dev/null || true)"
            MAKE_LATEST="--latest"
            if [ -n "$LATEST" ] && [ "${LATEST##*.}" -gt "$GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER" ] 2> /dev/null; then
              MAKE_LATEST="--latest=false"
            fi
            gh release create "$TAG" "$DMG" "$APPCAST" \
              --target "$GITHUB_SHA" \
              --title "Frame Job $VERSION" \
              --generate-notes \
              "$MAKE_LATEST"
          fi

      - name: Clean up signing material
        if: always()
        run: |
          security delete-keychain "$KEYCHAIN" 2> /dev/null || true
          rm -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/cert.p12" "$RUNNER_TEMP/AuthKey.p8" "$ED_KEY"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""The encoder build (road map "codec-export" C0, spec §11 CX-4, CX-5): SVT-AV1 and
libvpx, fetched as pinned tarballs, checked by SHA-256, built arm64, static and
encoder-only at the app's deployment target, and installed into `build/codecs/`.

    python3 tools/codecs/build_codecs.py              # build or reuse
    python3 tools/codecs/build_codecs.py --selftest   # no network, no cmake
    python3 tools/codecs/build_codecs.py --mutant key-no-tools|reuse-unchecked|sha-unchecked

`make codecs` and project.yml's "Build Codecs" pre-build step both run it. It prints
`codecs: reused <key>` or `codecs: built <key> in <s> s` on stdout. The install is
`build/codecs/`: `include/`, `lib/libSvtAv1Enc.a`, `lib/libvpx.a`,
`licenses/<library>/<file>` and `stamp.json` ({"key", "inputs", "outputs"}). It is reused
only when the stamp's key equals this run's key (sha256 over this file's bytes, PINS,
the tool versions and DEPLOYMENT_TARGET) AND every output still hashes as recorded.

ROOT is this file's RESOLVED path, so a tree copy (`tools/proof/tree_copy.py`, whose
`tools/` is a symlink) builds and reuses the tree's own `build/codecs/`, under LOCK.
Every build line, and `tool_versions()`, runs under `build_env()`, so a shell's
`make codecs` and Xcode's step compute one key. The tarballs are kept in
`build/codecs-downloads/`; a download whose digest is not the pin's is deleted and the
build fails, naming both digests. `tools/codecs/PROVENANCE.md` records each pin.

A `--mutant` runs the selftest alone and must fail exactly its rows: `key-no-tools` (the
tool versions left out of the key) K1; `reuse-unchecked` (a stamp reused without hashing
its outputs) R1 R2; `sha-unchecked` (a download kept without comparing its digest) S1.
Stdlib only, Python 3.9 (`/usr/bin/python3`, which Xcode's step finds first).
"""

import argparse
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import NamedTuple


class Pin(NamedTuple):
    name: str
    version: str
    url: str
    sha256: str
    commit: str  # `git get-tar-commit-id` of the tarball
    archive: str
    licenses: tuple  # ((path in the source tree, installed name), ...)


PINS = (
    Pin("svt-av1", "4.2.0",
        "https://gitlab.com/AOMediaCodec/SVT-AV1/-/archive/v4.2.0/SVT-AV1-v4.2.0.tar.gz",
        "c7b13c4a84bd3751aa35fcc72be13e6875467e7c2216879251a486e5b1e4e740",
        "9292ec8e32bce26f781f277ec8739b53426c4300",
        "libSvtAv1Enc.a",
        (("LICENSE.md", "LICENSE.md"), ("LICENSE-BSD2.md", "LICENSE-BSD2.md"),
         ("PATENTS.md", "PATENTS.md"),
         ("third_party/fastfeat/LICENSE", "fastfeat-LICENSE"),
         ("third_party/safestringlib/LICENSE", "safestringlib-LICENSE"))),
    Pin("libvpx", "1.17.0",
        "https://github.com/webmproject/libvpx/archive/refs/tags/v1.17.0.tar.gz",
        "1020f184046187baa2985dbde38e0691f49c44088bca7a1842b0236c6081dc0a",
        "6df3ec34557879fff673706f4a1d9fbd0f3a6f0e",
        "libvpx.a",
        (("LICENSE", "LICENSE"), ("PATENTS", "PATENTS"), ("AUTHORS", "AUTHORS"))),
)
DEPLOYMENT_TARGET = "26.0"
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
INSTALL = ROOT / "build/codecs"
DOWNLOADS = ROOT / "build/codecs-downloads"
WORK = ROOT / "build/codecs-work"
LOCK = ROOT / "build/codecs.lock"
CMAKE_DIRS = ("/opt/homebrew/bin", "/usr/local/bin")
SYSTEM_PATH = "/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin"
EXPECTED = {"key-no-tools": {"K1"}, "reuse-unchecked": {"R1", "R2"},
            "sha-unchecked": {"S1"}}
MUTANT = None


class BuildFailed(RuntimeError):
    pass


def sha256(path):
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        for block in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
            digest.update(block)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def find_cmake():
    """`cmake` on PATH, else in each CMAKE_DIRS entry (Xcode's PATH may lack Homebrew)."""
    found = shutil.which("cmake")
    if found:
        return Path(found)
    for folder in CMAKE_DIRS:
        candidate = Path(folder) / "cmake"
        if candidate.is_file() and os.access(candidate, os.X_OK):
            return candidate
    raise BuildFailed("codecs: cmake not found on PATH or in "
                      f"{', '.join(CMAKE_DIRS)} — install it with `brew install cmake`")


def build_env():
    """The scrubbed environment every build line and `tool_versions()` run under."""
    env = {"HOME": os.environ.get("HOME", "/tmp"), "LANG": "C",
           "TMPDIR": os.environ.get("TMPDIR", "/tmp"),
           "MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET": DEPLOYMENT_TARGET,
           "PATH": f"{SYSTEM_PATH}:{find_cmake().parent}"}
    if os.environ.get("DEVELOPER_DIR"):
        env["DEVELOPER_DIR"] = os.environ["DEVELOPER_DIR"]
    return env


def _output(argv, env):
    done = subprocess.run(argv, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
    if done.returncode != 0:
        raise BuildFailed(f"codecs: {' '.join(map(str, argv))} exited {done.returncode}: "
                          + (done.stderr or done.stdout).strip()[-300:])
    return (done.stdout + done.stderr).strip()


def tool_versions():
    env = build_env()
    return {"clang": _output(["xcrun", "clang", "--version"], env),
            "cmake": _output([str(find_cmake()), "--version"], env),
            "sdk": _output(["xcrun", "--show-sdk-version"], env)}


def gather_inputs():
    return {"script": sha256(__file__), "pins": [list(p) for p in PINS],
            "tools": tool_versions(), "deployment_target": DEPLOYMENT_TARGET}


def key(inputs):
    """sha256 hex over this file's bytes, PINS, the tool versions and DEPLOYMENT_TARGET."""
    document = dict(inputs)
    if MUTANT == "key-no-tools":
        document.pop("tools", None)
    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(document, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()


def verdict(stamp, want):
    """("reuse"|"build", reason): reuse only with an equal key and every output as recorded."""
    try:
        recorded = json.loads(Path(stamp).read_text())
        outputs = recorded["outputs"]
        if not isinstance(outputs, dict) or not outputs:
            return "build", "the stamp records no outputs"
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return "build", "no stamp"
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as error:
        return "build", f"the stamp is unreadable ({error})"
    if recorded.get("key") != want:
        return "build", f"the key changed ({str(recorded.get('key'))[:16]} → {want[:16]})"
    if MUTANT != "reuse-unchecked":
        top = Path(stamp).parent
        for relative, digest in sorted(outputs.items()):
            path = top / relative
            if not path.is_file():
                return "build", f"{relative} is missing"
            if sha256(path) != digest:
                return "build", f"{relative} no longer hashes as recorded"
    return "reuse", "the stamp's key and every output match"


def check_download(path, expected):
    """Raises naming both digests, and deletes the file, unless it hashes to `expected`."""
    actual = sha256(path)
    if actual != expected and MUTANT != "sha-unchecked":
        Path(path).unlink()
        raise BuildFailed(f"codecs: {Path(path).name} has SHA-256 {actual}, expected "
                          f"{expected}; it was deleted")


def _fetch(pin):
    DOWNLOADS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path = DOWNLOADS / pin.url.rsplit("/", 1)[1]
    if path.is_file() and sha256(path) == pin.sha256:
        return path
    part = path.with_name(path.name + ".part")
    print(f"codecs: fetching {pin.url}", file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
    done = subprocess.run(["/usr/bin/curl", "-fsSL", "--retry", "3", "-o", str(part), pin.url],
                          capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600)
    if done.returncode != 0:
        part.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        raise BuildFailed(f"codecs: fetching {pin.url} failed (curl {done.returncode}): "
                          + done.stderr.strip()[-300:])
    os.replace(part, path)
    check_download(path, pin.sha256)
    return path


def _run(argv, cwd, env, log):
    log.write(f"$ (cd {cwd}) {' '.join(map(str, argv))}\n")
    log.flush()
    done = subprocess.run([str(a) for a in argv], cwd=str(cwd), env=env, stdout=log,
                          stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    if done.returncode != 0:
        raise BuildFailed(f"codecs: {Path(str(argv[0])).name} exited {done.returncode} "
                          f"in {cwd} (log {log.name})")


def _build_one(pin, tarball, env, jobs):
    """Extract, configure, build and install one library into WORK/<name>/stage."""
    top = WORK / pin.name
    shutil.rmtree(top, ignore_errors=True)
    (top / "build").mkdir(parents=True)
    stage = top / "stage"
    with open(WORK / f"{pin.name}.log", "w") as log:
        _run(["/usr/bin/tar", "-xzf", tarball, "-C", top], top, env, log)
        sources = [p for p in top.iterdir() if p.is_dir() and p.name not in ("build", "stage")]
        if len(sources) != 1:
            raise BuildFailed(f"codecs: {tarball.name} unpacked to {sorted(map(str, sources))}")
        source, build = sources[0], top / "build"
        if pin.name == "svt-av1":
            _run(["cmake", "-G", "Unix Makefiles", "-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release",
                  "-DCMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES=arm64",
                  f"-DCMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET={DEPLOYMENT_TARGET}",
                  f"-DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX={stage}", "-DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF",
                  "-DBUILD_DEC=OFF", "-DBUILD_APPS=OFF", "-DBUILD_TESTING=OFF",
                  "-S", source, "-B", build], build, env, log)
            _run(["cmake", "--build", build, f"-j{jobs}"], build, env, log)
            _run(["cmake", "--install", build], build, env, log)
        else:
            _run([source / "configure", "--target=arm64-darwin25-gcc", f"--prefix={stage}",
                  "--enable-static", "--disable-shared", "--disable-vp8", "--enable-vp9",
                  "--enable-vp9-highbitdepth", "--disable-vp9-decoder", "--disable-examples",
                  "--disable-tools", "--disable-unit-tests", "--disable-docs",
                  "--disable-webm-io", "--disable-libyuv"], build, env, log)
            _run(["make", f"-j{jobs}"], build, env, log)
            _run(["make", "install"], build, env, log)
    return source, stage


def _assemble(built, target):
    """include/, lib/<archive> and licenses/<name>/ from each stage into `target`."""
    for pin, (source, stage) in built:
        archive = stage / "lib" / pin.archive
        if not archive.is_file():
            raise BuildFailed(f"codecs: {pin.name} installed no {pin.archive}")
        (target / "lib").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy2(archive, target / "lib" / pin.archive)
        shutil.copytree(stage / "include", target / "include", dirs_exist_ok=True)
        licences = target / "licenses" / pin.name
        licences.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        for inside, installed in pin.licenses:
            shutil.copyfile(source / inside, licences / installed)


def _outputs(top):
    return {p.relative_to(top).as_posix(): sha256(p)
            for p in sorted(top.rglob("*")) if p.is_file() and p.name != "stamp.json"}


def build_or_reuse():
    started = time.monotonic()
    LOCK.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with open(LOCK, "w") as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX)  # a racing build of the same tree waits, then reuses
        inputs = gather_inputs()
        want = key(inputs)
        action, reason = verdict(INSTALL / "stamp.json", want)
        if action == "reuse":
            print(f"codecs: reused {want}", flush=True)
            return 0
        print(f"codecs: building ({reason})", file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
        env, jobs = build_env(), os.cpu_count() or 4
        WORK.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        built = [(pin, _build_one(pin, _fetch(pin), env, jobs)) for pin in PINS]
        fresh = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="codecs.new-", dir=INSTALL.parent))
        try:
            _assemble(built, fresh)
            stamp = {"key": want, "inputs": inputs, "outputs": _outputs(fresh)}
            (fresh / "stamp.json").write_text(json.dumps(stamp, indent=1, sort_keys=True))
            fresh.chmod(0o755)
            old = INSTALL.parent / f"codecs.old-{os.getpid()}"
            if INSTALL.exists():
                os.rename(INSTALL, old)
            os.rename(fresh, INSTALL)
            shutil.rmtree(old, ignore_errors=True)
        finally:
            shutil.rmtree(fresh, ignore_errors=True)
        shutil.rmtree(WORK, ignore_errors=True)
        print(f"codecs: built {want} in {time.monotonic() - started:.0f} s", flush=True)
        return 0


# ---- the selftest: no network, no cmake ------------------------------------------


def selftest(mutant=None):
    global MUTANT, CMAKE_DIRS
    MUTANT, results = mutant, []

    def row(name, ok, detail):
        results.append((name, bool(ok)))
        print(f"  {'ok  ' if ok else 'FAIL'} {name} {detail}", flush=True)

    scratch = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="build_codecs-selftest-"))
    saved_path, saved_dirs = os.environ.get("PATH", ""), CMAKE_DIRS
    try:
        base = {"script": "a" * 64, "pins": [list(p) for p in PINS],
                "tools": {"clang": "clang 1", "cmake": "cmake 1", "sdk": "26.0"},
                "deployment_target": DEPLOYMENT_TARGET}
        first = key(base)
        row("K0", first == key(dict(base)) and len(first) == 64,
            f"CONTROL: the same inputs twice give {first[:16]}")
        tools = {**base, "tools": {**base["tools"], "cmake": "cmake 2"}}
        sdk = {**base, "tools": {**base["tools"], "sdk": "26.1"}}
        row("K1", key(tools) != first and key(sdk) != first,
            "a changed cmake version and a changed SDK each change the key: "
            f"{key(tools) != first}, {key(sdk) != first}")
        pins = [list(p) for p in PINS]
        pins[1][3] = "0" * 64
        changes = {"the script's bytes": key({**base, "script": "b" * 64}),
                   "a pin's digest": key({**base, "pins": pins}),
                   "the deployment target": key({**base, "deployment_target": "27.0"})}
        same = [name for name, value in changes.items() if value == first]
        row("K2", not same, f"changed for {len(changes) - len(same)}/{len(changes)}"
            + (f" (unchanged: {same})" if same else ""))

        install = scratch / "install"
        (install / "lib").mkdir(parents=True)
        (install / "lib/libx.a").write_bytes(b"archive-1")
        (install / "licenses").mkdir()
        (install / "licenses/LICENSE").write_bytes(b"licence-1")

        def stamp(text_key=first):
            (install / "stamp.json").write_text(json.dumps(
                {"key": text_key, "inputs": base, "outputs": _outputs(install)}))
        stamp()
        r0 = verdict(install / "stamp.json", first)
        row("R0", r0[0] == "reuse", f"CONTROL: an equal key and equal outputs: {r0}")
        (install / "lib/libx.a").write_bytes(b"archive-2")
        r1 = verdict(install / "stamp.json", first)
        row("R1", r1[0] == "build" and "libx.a" in r1[1], f"an output's byte changed: {r1}")
        (install / "lib/libx.a").unlink()
        r2 = verdict(install / "stamp.json", first)
        row("R2", r2[0] == "build" and "missing" in r2[1], f"an output removed: {r2}")
        (install / "lib/libx.a").write_bytes(b"archive-1")
        r3 = verdict(install / "stamp.json", "f" * 64)
        r4 = verdict(scratch / "none.json", first)
        (scratch / "bad.json").write_text("{")
        r5 = verdict(scratch / "bad.json", first)
        row("R3", r3[0] == r4[0] == r5[0] == "build",
            f"another key, no stamp, a broken stamp all build: {r3}, {r4}, {r5}")

        good = scratch / "good.tar.gz"
        good.write_bytes(b"tarball")
        digest = hashlib.sha256(b"tarball").hexdigest()
        try:
            check_download(good, digest)
            row("S0", good.exists(), "CONTROL: a matching digest passes and keeps the file")
        except BuildFailed as error:
            row("S0", False, f"a matching digest raised: {error}")
        bad = scratch / "bad.tar.gz"
        bad.write_bytes(b"tampered")
        actual = hashlib.sha256(b"tampered").hexdigest()
        try:
            check_download(bad, digest)
            row("S1", False, f"a mismatched digest passed; the file kept: {bad.exists()}")
        except BuildFailed as error:
            named = digest in str(error) and actual in str(error)
            row("S1", named and not bad.exists(),
                f"raised naming both digests: {named}; deleted: {not bad.exists()}")

        problems = []
        for pin in PINS:
            if len(pin.sha256) != 64 or any(c not in "0123456789abcdef" for c in pin.sha256):
                problems.append(f"{pin.name}'s sha256")
            if len(pin.commit) != 40 or any(c not in "0123456789abcdef" for c in pin.commit):
                problems.append(f"{pin.name}'s commit")
            if not pin.url.startswith("https://") or f"v{pin.version}" not in pin.url:
                problems.append(f"{pin.name}'s url")
            if not pin.archive.endswith(".a") or not pin.licenses:
                problems.append(f"{pin.name}'s archive or licences")
        row("P1", not problems and [p.name for p in PINS] == ["svt-av1", "libvpx"],
            f"the pins are well formed: {problems or 'yes'}")

        fake = scratch / "brew-bin"
        fake.mkdir()
        (fake / "cmake").write_text("#!/bin/sh\necho cmake version 0\n")
        (fake / "cmake").chmod(0o755)
        os.environ["PATH"] = SYSTEM_PATH
        CMAKE_DIRS = (str(scratch / "absent"), str(fake))
        found = find_cmake() if shutil.which("cmake") is None else None
        env = build_env() if found else {}
        allowed = {"HOME", "TMPDIR", "LANG", "DEVELOPER_DIR", "MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET",
                   "PATH"}
        row("C1", found == fake / "cmake" and set(env) <= allowed
            and env.get("PATH") == f"{SYSTEM_PATH}:{fake}"
            and env.get("MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET") == DEPLOYMENT_TARGET,
            f"without Homebrew on PATH cmake is found in CMAKE_DIRS ({found}), and the "
            f"environment is {sorted(env)} with PATH {env.get('PATH')}")
        CMAKE_DIRS = (str(scratch / "absent"),)
        try:
            find_cmake()
            row("C2", False, "no cmake anywhere, and find_cmake answered one")
        except BuildFailed as error:
            row("C2", "brew install cmake" in str(error), f"no cmake raises: {error}")
    finally:
        os.environ["PATH"], CMAKE_DIRS = saved_path, saved_dirs
        shutil.rmtree(scratch, ignore_errors=True)

    failed = {name for name, ok in results if not ok}
    print(f"{len(results) - len(failed)}/{len(results)} rows pass")
    ok = failed == EXPECTED[mutant] if mutant else not failed
    print(f"MUTANT {'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'}: {mutant} failed {sorted(failed)}, expected "
          f"{sorted(EXPECTED[mutant])}" if mutant else "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
    return 0 if ok else 1


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="the encoder build (codec-export C0)")
    parser.add_argument("--selftest", action="store_true", help="K0–K2, R0–R3, S0–S1, P1, C1–C2")
    parser.add_argument("--mutant", choices=sorted(EXPECTED))
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
